source_differences: The US product page lists 7 1/2 by 1 3/4 by 13/16 inches, approximately 190.5 by 44.45 by 20.6375 mm, while both inspected manufacturer datasheet versions list 190 by 60 by 20 mm. They must not be silently averaged or treated as one exact jaw configuration.
The US page describes wire rope up to 13/64 inch, approximately 5.159 mm; the manufacturer metric table gives 5.0 mm. Use the explicit metric table for the candidate applicability record.
The 6 mm figure belongs to fine-stranded copper cable, not the wire-rope row.

limits: The selected station's 3 mm wire envelopes are themselves hypotheses; a catalogue capacity does not establish their actual material grade or cutting force.
Wire rope, copper cable and solid piano wire are distinct material cases. A 3 mm piano-wire request exceeds this tool's quoted 2.5 mm row.
Grasp span, contact, handle forces, severing, deformation and cut-end behavior require later validation after scene acceptance.
